scope: Proposition 3.3 (Particle-number free-energy bounds) of the manuscript “A density-uniform condensate bound for dilute Bose gases” (preprints/A-density-uniform-condensate-bound-for-dilute-Bose-gases-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 267 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5dceb5d5d293d6dc), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 7. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Uniformly in the temperature range under consideration, FN ≥ cvρN, (4) FN+k ≥ FN + cvρk (k ≥ 0). (5) For every bounded W ≥ 0, with no upper bound on its size required, F (−W) j − F (−W) j−1 ≤ Cvρ (1 ≤ j ≤ 4ρV ). (6) The constant in (6) is independent of W.
